findings.premise_violated: a frozen scoring rule must implement what it declares
findings.required_fix: Implement the declared normalization or narrow the declared scope, extend self-tests, and re-freeze the rule plus the receipt hash before any probe is authorized.
findings.root_cause: The frozen normalization text and the implementation diverged; self-tests never cover percent sign, dollar sign or the 'percent' scale word.

findings.premise_violated: pre-registration must describe the analysis actually executed
findings.required_fix: Align the receipt primary_metric and paired unit with the executed screen, or state the proxy explicitly. Immaterial: gap 10.671937 pp on 506 vs 10.650888 pp on 507.
findings.root_cause: Pre-generation screen uses an offline evidence ceiling as a proxy and the receipt was not updated to say so.
findings.symptom: Prereg primary_metric is full_semantic_answer_accuracy over 506 questions; the executed screen measures the margin on semantic_reference_potential over denominator 507. full_semantic_answer_accuracy is computed nowhere.
